A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders.
While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information. Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it.
The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate.

In the wake of these events, Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO while Wall Street and the Board evaluate potential permanent successors, including external candidates such as Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-following-jensen-huangs-resignation-as-ceo-allegations-of-a-third-affair-emerge-195535310.html)).

Despite executive-level headwinds, NVIDIA's operational and financial foundation remains exceptionally robust, underscored by its performance through fiscal 2026.
